concepts.subject: Diverse team meeting space
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a bright and modern conference room with a large wooden table, diverse team of 5 people, natural light pouring in, warm colors, and a relaxed atmosphere. Capture from a slightly elevated angle, with the camera positioned at the head of the table. Incorporate laptops, notebooks, and a large screen display.
concepts.title: Modern Conference Room Meeting
concepts.description: A group of diverse colleagues gathered around a large wooden table in a modern conference room, engaged in a discussion with laptops and notebooks open. Natural light pours in through the large windows.

concepts.subject: Active senior outdoors hiking
concepts.image_prompt: Create a scenic outdoor image of a fit senior citizen hiking on a winding trail, surrounded by lush green trees and a clear blue sky. Capture from a low angle, looking up, with warm sunlight casting a slight glow. Incorporate a walking stick and a backpack.
concepts.title: Senior Citizen Hiking Outdoors
concepts.description: A fit and active senior citizen, dressed in hiking gear, walking on a winding trail surrounded by lush green trees and a clear blue sky. The senior citizen is using a walking stick and wearing a backpack.

concepts.subject: Fresh fruit salad bowl
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a colorful and vibrant image of a large bowl filled with a variety of fresh fruits, such as strawberries, blueberries, and pineapple. Capture from directly above, with natural light illuminating the scene. Incorporate a few fresh mint leaves and a spoon.
concepts.title: Fresh Fruit Salad Bowl
concepts.description: A large bowl filled with a variety of fresh fruits, including strawberries, blueberries, and pineapple, garnished with fresh mint leaves and a spoon.

concepts.subject: Young programmer working
concepts.image_prompt: Create a modern and sleek image of a young programmer sitting in front of a large computer screen, coding away. Capture from a 45-degree angle, with softbox lighting illuminating the scene. Incorporate a few coding books and a cup of coffee.
concepts.title: Young Programmer Working Late
concepts.description: A young programmer sitting in front of a large computer screen, typing away on their keyboard, surrounded by coding books and a cup of coffee.

concepts.subject: Serene mountain landscape
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a breathtaking and serene image of a mountain landscape, with a calm lake in the foreground and majestic mountains rising up in the background. Capture from a low angle, looking up, with warm sunlight casting a golden glow. Incorporate a few trees and rocks.
concepts.title: Serene Mountain Landscape Scene
concepts.description: A breathtaking mountain landscape with a calm lake in the foreground and majestic mountains rising up in the background, surrounded by trees and rocks.

concepts.subject: Diverse group friends laughing
concepts.image_prompt: Create a vibrant and joyful image of a diverse group of friends laughing and having fun together, with different ethnicities, ages, and abilities represented. Capture from a medium angle, with natural light illuminating the scene. Incorporate a few fun props like hats and sunglasses.
concepts.title: Diverse Group of Friends Laughing
concepts.description: A diverse group of friends, including people of different ethnicities, ages, and abilities, laughing and having fun together, with fun props like hats and sunglasses.

concepts.subject: Mindful meditation practice
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a peaceful and calming image of a person practicing mindful meditation, sitting in a serene outdoor setting, surrounded by nature. Capture from a low angle, looking up, with soft natural light illuminating the scene. Incorporate a few props like a meditation cushion and a guided meditation book.
concepts.title: Mindful Meditation Practice Outdoors
concepts.description: A person sitting in a serene outdoor setting, practicing mindful meditation, surrounded by nature, with a meditation cushion and a guided meditation book nearby.

concepts.subject: Home office workspace setup
concepts.image_prompt: Create a modern and organized image of a home office workspace setup, with a desk, chair, and computer, surrounded by plants and good natural light. Capture from a medium angle, with softbox lighting illuminating the scene. Incorporate a few productivity tools like a planner and a coffee cup.
concepts.title: Home Office Workspace Setup
concepts.description: A modern and organized home office workspace setup, with a desk, chair, and computer, surrounded by plants and good natural light, with productivity tools like a planner and a coffee cup nearby.

concepts.subject: Fitness class exercise routine
concepts.image_prompt: Generate a high-energy and motivational image of a fitness class exercise routine, with a diverse group of people engaging in a variety of exercises, such as yoga, Pilates, or weightlifting. Capture from a medium angle, with bright and colorful lighting illuminating the scene. Incorporate a few fitness props like mats, dumbbells, and resistance bands.
concepts.title: Fitness Class Exercise Routine
concepts.description: A diverse group of people engaging in a variety of exercises, such as yoga, Pilates, or weightlifting, in a fitness class setting, with fitness props like mats, dumbbells, and resistance bands nearby.

concepts.subject: Renewable energy solar panels
concepts.image_prompt: Create a futuristic and sustainable image of renewable energy solar panels, installed on a modern building or in a field, with a clear blue sky and fluffy white clouds in the background. Capture from a low angle, looking up, with warm sunlight casting a slight glow. Incorporate a few props like wind turbines or a recycling symbol.
concepts.title: Renewable Energy Solar Panels
concepts.description: A modern building or field with renewable energy solar panels installed, with a clear blue sky and fluffy white clouds in the background, and wind turbines or a recycling symbol nearby.
